title: Cute Chubby Retro 4 slice toaster..The more its used, the worst it toasts!
text:
Cute Chubby Retro 4 slice toaster..The more its used, the worst it toasts!. I just wrote this review, but after using this toaster a few more times, I’m Very disappointed again about this R.H.toaster.
Every slot We put the same type of toast in, at the same time came out different. Some where toasted more, some where only toasted on one side,
And some where toasted on the top and bottom, but not the middle! What the heck!
Going from a 4 star down to a Two, and thats being generous!
That said, this is a good looking toaster..Big deal it doesnt toast even?. Grrrrrrrr
——————————
Nice Chubby Retro looking 4 slice Russell Hobbs toaster.
The Cream color adds to the Retro good looks of this toaster. (Also Getting tired of wiping chrome toaster All the time)

This R.H.Toaster is replacing my chrome glass front R.H. 2 Slice toaster that never toasted good!, ($99.95 & Very lite weight)
I was taking a chance with another R.H. , but we needed a 4 slice toaster.
Before the RH. Chrome glass toaster, we did have a chrome 4 slice dualit heavy toaster. ( I’m so over expensive toasters)

Now this R.H. Is easier to use, as the side buttons are larger to read, and not as many.
It is not as long as the 2 slice, but is deeper..it is a Chubby toaster, and not heavy to pull out from under the cabinet.

This comes with a wire rack that fits on top to warm rolls, croissants etc, but do not put anything with frosting, or anything dripping
On the rack, you will ruin this toaster.

If you want your toast darker, first press down to toast, then move the side lever to a higher number.
The same goes if your toasting frozen bread. First put the bread in press to toast, then press the button with the snowflake.
If you want to pop your toast up, or stop the toaster, push on the arrow botton.
There is also a botton for sliced bagels.
The Gauge on the front looks good, but it shows you how much longer till your toast is done.

We had to play around wth the Lever a little bit too figure out what number is right for how dark or light we like our toast.

There is one problem I do Not like about this toaster.
To empty the crumb trays, I have to unplug, pull the toaster away from the wall, turn the toaster around to the back and pull out the two Crumb Trays, that are hidden in the back-bottom .
Once you find them , its easy, just a pain in the neck, cause we use a toaster often. The kids like Frozen Waffles, Bagels,
And breads with seeds etc..

product_metadata.title: Russell Hobbs TR9250WTR Retro Style Toaster, 4-Slice, White
features: Toasting Timer - The countdown timer shows precisely how long it takes to toast bread to the shade you’ve selected.
Removable Bun Warmer - This wire rack attaches to the top of the toaster, allowing for easy warming of buns, pastries, and rolls. Remove for normal toasting.
Lift & Look - Monitor the progress of toasting without canceling the heating cycle.
Three Functions - The Bagel function ideally toasts both sides of the bagel. The Frozen setting adjusts toasting to achieve results identical to fresh bread. Cancel ends toasting.
Six Toast Shades - Select the level of doneness you prefer, from 1 (light) to 6 (dark).
description: From your gas range to your stainless steel refrigerator you’ve carefully selected every appliance to match your kitchen's style. Why stop there when smaller details can add the all-important finishing touch? make your kitchen feel a little more distinguished with the eye-catching Russell Hobbs 4-Slice retro style toaster in our premium polished White finish. classic retro-styling meets modern innovation for premium toasting performance. This 4-Slice toaster features a countdown timer that shows precisely how much time remains on the toasting cycle. The variable browning control ranges from 1 (light) to 6 (dark) to satisfy all preferences. Choose the bagel function for a perfectly toasted cut side with a warmed bottom side or the frozen setting for fresh-like results. This toaster comes with a removable warming rack that quickly heats buns, pastries, and rolls. Plus, the removable crumb tray ensures easy cleanup.
